name: Bold.co

webhook.algorithm: VERIFIED. Header `x-bold-signature`. Algorithm HMAC-SHA256, output hex. IMPORTANT: the signed message is the BASE64 encoding of the request body, not the raw body — a generator that hashes the raw body will fail every time. NO timestamp is covered, so replay mitigation must be event-id dedup only. Events: SALE_APPROVED, SALE_REJECTED, VOID_APPROVED, VOID_REJECTED. Sandbox quirk: the signature is computed with an EMPTY key.

evidence.note: Catalog import from adversarially-checked research. The scheme above is quoted from that research and has NOT been transcribed into typed fields, so PagoKit will not generate a verifier. Promoting this provider to generic or build means reading the provider docs and typing the scheme in.

credentials.note: Paired identity key and secret key, per environment (production/testing), retrieved from the merchant panel. No documented prefix — leave regex null. Note the webhook selects a signing key by payment method, so a merchant may hold several.

fees.notes: UNKNOWN. Bold publishes marketing rates that vary by method and by promotional period; none verified against docs. Do not populate.

notes: The fastest-growing Colombian acquirer and the main self-serve alternative to Wompi (Bancolombia-owned). Gives PagoKit a second CO option that is not tied to one bank, with a clean, fully documented HMAC scheme.
SDKs: No official server SDK verified. Official WooCommerce/WordPress plugins and a JS payment button exist. REST-only.
Developer-experience scores are unrated placeholders (3/3); they are not used in ranking.
Overlaps: Direct competitor to the already-shipped wompi. Add as the non-Bancolombia option; both should carry bre_b once it is exposed via their APIs.
Onboarding model was inferred during the catalog import and is not verified. Confirm it before relying on the "can this user actually get keys" filter.
